# Guildon: Crafts & Recipes

Part of Guildon, for World of Warcraft: Forever and Classic Era: professions and recipes of the guild, wish list with orders, trade and mail help, shared auction prices.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1775548

The full description (German) is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues,
please add the text of `/gnc diag`.
